digest.component_or_area: bridge preview and reconcile command routing
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass, without launching or reimplementing reconcile-check.
Canonical bridge preview must remain lock-free, acquiring neither pass locks nor performing any lock mutations, while legacy reconcile-check retains its independent lock-free diagnostic branch.

Argparse abbreviation ambiguity must be eliminated by setting allow_abbrev=False on the engine parser, causing undocumented prefix abbreviations (e.g. --dry-run) to fail with invocation error 2 before reads or mutations, while documented legacy options and bridge preview remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must share the same field-comparable manifest envelope and contract, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers across CLI, library, MCP, and workflows retain the historical tally-only no-retained-manifest behavior unchanged.

Legacy reconcile-check, legacy dry-run, legacy live, and bootstrap capped-sync routes must retain their existing observable behavior, output format, and exit semantics without inference or rewriting from the canonical presentation disposition.
